posts.community: Alpex Solar Ltd - Stunning sun powered performance?
posts.text: Is it 2.2 GW or 1.6 GW. They don’t have environment Clearance till now. They can’t produce without EC. ALMM team can’t visit unless an active production facility is in place. Every manufacturer go through a long learning curve before achieving targeted Cell efficiency, capacity utilization & line stabilization. It can take anytime between 60-90 days for an experienced Cell manufacturer from the day 1. For Alpex, it may take more time. So, I think they will be able to show consistant numbers from Cell line from Mar-2027 onwards which will reflect in Q1,FY28 numbers. I may be wrong in my opinion…
